Overview

Jazan is a city in Jazan with a population of 255,000. The capital of the Jazan Region in southwestern Saudi Arabia, a port city on the Red Sea coast. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 300 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
